tasks.label: perf
tasks.command: npm run build; node performance/current-bench.cjs plains_1 swing-only 1000; node performance/current-bench.cjs plains_3 swing-only 1000; node performance/current-bench.cjs plains_3 random 300

tasks.label: profile
tasks.command: npm run build; node --cpu-prof --cpu-prof-interval=500 --cpu-prof-dir=performance\profiles --cpu-prof-name=plains1-swing.cpuprofile performance/current-bench.cjs plains_1 swing-only 1000; node --cpu-prof --cpu-prof-interval=500 --cpu-prof-dir=performance\profiles --cpu-prof-name=plains3-swing.cpuprofile performance/current-bench.cjs plains_3 swing-only 1000; node --cpu-prof --cpu-prof-interval=500 --cpu-prof-dir=performance\profiles --cpu-prof-name=plains3-random.cpuprofile performance/current-bench.cjs plains_3 random 300
